decision.reason: [ev-f387a976e3cf] is only a one-line CHANGELOG title saying the servers load-balancer was reworked to use "the WRR", and it points to PR #9431. It doesn't say what the earlier algorithm was or which configurations (for example weighted servers, health checks or sticky sessions) behave differently. It also doesn't say what an operator who does nothing would see. To write the applicability and consequence aspects we would need the PR description, migration guide text or docs that describe the behaviour difference.
